name: redactor
description: Masks secrets and personal data in tool results before the model ever reads them.

secrets.title: Mask secrets
secrets.description: API keys and tokens (AWS, GitHub, Anthropic, OpenAI, Stripe, Slack, Google), JWTs, private keys and high-entropy *_KEY / *_SECRET / *_TOKEN / PASSWORD values.

phones.title: Mask phone numbers
phones.description: International (+...) and North American formatted phone numbers.

ibans.title: Mask IBANs
ibans.description: Bank account numbers that pass the IBAN mod-97 checksum.

cards.title: Mask payment cards
cards.description: Card numbers with a known issuer prefix that pass the Luhn check.

privateIps.title: Mask private IPv4 addresses
privateIps.description: 10.x, 172.16-31.x and 192.168.x addresses. Off by default: they are rarely sensitive and often useful.

allowlist.title: Allowlist (regex)
allowlist.description: Matches this regular expression are left visible. Empty to mask everything.
